chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 267: The Dao-Soldier Hall – A Unity Forged by Desperation
chapter_meta_description: The team clears the Dao-Soldier Hall, but the real threat emerges: the estate’s native beasts have united into a single, deadly army. The last stand begins in Desolate Era Chapter 267.
og_description: Twenty thousand Dao-soldiers, one Heavenly Dao oath, and a warship flying straight into the trap. Desolate Era Chapter 267 sets the stage for the final confrontation.
twitter_title: They’re All Pointed at the Same Target
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s team clears the Dao-Soldier Hall only to find two branch halls guarded by a unified beast army. The estate’s final trial is here.

lore_anchors.definition: A type of magic armor inscribed with runes that allows multiple soldiers to fuse their strength, commonly used by elite troops in the Grand Xia Dynasty.
An oath sworn on the supreme cosmic laws of the universe. Breaking it invites karmic backlash and spiritual devastation, making it the most binding vow a cultivator can make.
A type of Dao-soldier armor that produces a watery, wave-like formation; used by the Wu Jiang Immortal for massed troops.
A superior variant of Dao-soldier armor that manifests a giant, translucent specter of a hunchbacked yaksha holding an iron fork; used by the elite Wu Jiang clan.
An ancient, savage divine being from primordial chaos, characterized by immense size and raw power.
A rare divine beast known for its speed, spatial teleportation abilities, and talent for finding treasures.
A divine beast with powerful comprehension and high intelligence, often serving as a wise guardian or companion to cultivators.
A demonic beast that has formed a master-servant bond with a cultivator, often stored in a special talisman and summoned at will.
A quality classification for magic treasures below the Immortal-ranked level, very powerful but not yet sentient.
A high-tier magic treasure that possesses its own artifact spirit and sentience.
